svg.title: HyperWeave — facet
svg.desc: Flat faceting: the cushion split at its own diagonals into alternating light and deep ink — value assigned by form under one implied light, no gradients anywhere.

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Dimension the honest way: two flat tones whose boundary IS the geometry.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Base fill #2E7CFF with the right and left quadrants overlaid in #0A45D6 through a diagonal clip whose seams pass exactly through the tips and center — the value change happens only where a real facet edge would be, which is why it connects where the ramp did not.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Faceting quotes the retired octahedron's volume language in flat form — deliberate heritage. At 16px the two tones merge toward a single mid-ink, so this variant degrades INTO monolith rather than into mud.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: 64x64, bilateral about (32,32); cushion cardinals +/-29; core anchored at center. Static and filter-free by set doctrine: identity first, motion is a layer added after selection.
